summary: Backend + frontend E2E tested. 30/30 backend pytest passed. Frontend flows work (login, module navigation, task create + auto progress 50%, theme toggle, global search, delete). Found one confirmed frontend BUG: converting a newly-added action item in MeetingDetail hits 404 because addAction pushes an item without an id to local state (backend generates the id but frontend never re-reads it) — the convert button then renders data-testid=btn-convert-undefined and POSTs /action-items/undefined/convert → 404.

ui_bugs.issue: Newly added action item lacks id in local state → btn-convert-<undefined>, POST /meetings/{id}/action-items/undefined/convert returns 404; also causes React 'unique key' warning. Fix: after PUT /meetings/{id}, set state from response (which has normalized ids), e.g. `const { data } = await api.put(...); setMeeting(data);`

integration_issues.flow: Meeting → Convert action item to task (fresh item added in UI)
integration_issues.issue: Convert always 404s until user reloads the page (existing seeded items with ids convert fine — verified via backend test 30/30)

issues: Radix DialogContent missing DialogTitle/aria-describedby (console warnings). Global search Command dialog and confirm-delete dialogs are affected — a11y only, not blocking.

action_items: Fix MeetingDetail.updateActionItems to use PUT response so newly-added action items get their server-generated id in local state (unblocks one-click convert without reload).
Add DialogTitle (or VisuallyHidden) + aria-describedby to Radix dialogs to remove a11y console warnings (Global search CommandDialog, task-create Dialog, confirm-delete AlertDialogs).
critical_code_review_comments: routers/attachments.py: get_current_user imported twice (get_current_user as _gcu unused).
routers/tasks.py compute(): status defaults to 'Pending' even when saved manually as 'Draft/Cancelled/Archived' — that is intended (MANUAL_STATUSES bypass) and correct.
aggregate.py calendar: fine but note task.deadline[:10] assumes ISO date string; if a non-ISO deadline is stored it silently produces bad date — acceptable given input validation elsewhere.
MeetingDetail addAction bug (see above) is the only functional defect found.

success_rate.frontend: ~90% (1 integration bug on convert-fresh-action-item; all navigation, task auto-progress, theme, global search, CRUD OK)

seed_data_creation: Tests create TEST_-prefixed data and clean up after themselves. E2E-created meeting/task also deleted post-run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend test file at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py — run with `pytest backend/tests/backend_test.py -v`. If MeetingDetail addAction is fixed, re-run the Playwright convert flow to confirm link-converted-<id> appears without reload.
rca of the issue: MeetingDetail.jsx `addAction` builds a new action_item locally without id then calls updateActionItems which optimistically stores that raw list in state and fires PUT /meetings/{id}. Backend `_norm_items` generates ids and persists them, and PUT returns the full meeting with ids, but the frontend ignores the response body and keeps the id-less list in state. When the user clicks the newly rendered Convert button, `a.id` is undefined, producing `POST /api/meetings/{id}/action-items/undefined/convert` → 404 'Action item tidak ditemukan'. Reproduction: create meeting → open detail → type action item → click + → click Jadikan Tugas → observe network 404 and toast error. Mitigation: replace `try { await api.put(...); } catch ...` with `const { data } = await api.put(...); setMeeting(data);` (or call load() after PUT). Existing seeded action items (which already have ids) convert successfully — backend test suite confirms the API works end-to-end.
